package.description: Pretty-print JSON slog logs from stdin, files, or follow mode

en-US.description: Pretty-print JSON slog logs from stdin, files, or follow mode
en-US.longDescription:
logx is a small, zero-dependency CLI that consumes JSON slog records
(the standard log/slog format) and renders them as colored,
human-friendly lines. It supports stdin pipelines, file arguments,
tail-style follow mode, level filtering, and substring grep, and
passes through non-JSON lines unchanged so panics aren't swallowed.
en-US.name: logx
